lines.t: Do not put your trust in idols, nor in any man-made image forged of stone or marble, or of wood or brass, gold or of fine metal; there is no life in it! For they can not speak or walk; they have no power at all.
Yea, men bear them upon their shoulders, for they can not move from their places. They have no strength, they are helpless, worthless images carved in futility and must be borne.
there is no life in it! For they can not speak or walk; they have no power at all.
Look how easily they are toppled
By the wind and broken in pieces,
When the earth is shaken but a little...
